Cc: programs@seedfund.org
Date: Sun, 09 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Redwood credits for OrbitVC cohort — eligibility question

Hi Aditya,

We run a summer cohort for early-stage teams (OrbitVC Summer '26) and several of our portfolio companies are excited to try Redwood for inference. A few founders asked if we can get complimentary credits for the program to help them prototype.

Quick context: cohort has 11 startups, most pre-Series A; we support them with 3 months of cloud credits typically. We want to see if Redwood offers accelerator credits or a trial extension that can be auto-issued to verified program participants.

Attached is a roster and a sample proof of incorporation for one company for your verification.

Asks:
- Is there a self-serve verification flow you can point us to?
- What evidence do you require to issue credits?
- Typical credit amount you provide for accelerator cohorts?

Thanks — happy to jump on a quick call if that helps.

Best,
Emma Linton
Program Director, OrbitVC
[Attachment: accelerator_roster.csv]
[Attachment: startup-proof-of-incorporation.png]

From: aditya_rao@redwood.ai

Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 09 Aug 2026 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood credits for OrbitVC cohort — eligibility question

Thanks Emma — and congrats on the cohort.

Short answer: yes, we have a self-serve accelerator verification path that supports automatic issuance once the program is validated. It speeds up onboarding and avoids manual redlines for small cohorts.

What I need from you to kick this off:
- Confirmation of the program website or public announcement (we verify organizers)
- A roster of startups with company names + account email (CSV is perfect)
- One piece of proof per company (incorporation docs, accelerator acceptance email, or investor intro)

Next steps I can offer immediately:
- I created a verification link you can use to upload docs and map participant emails: https://console.redwood.ai/credits/verify?token=6f4b-verify
- If you prefer, reply here with the roster and I’ll kick off verification and assign credits to those accounts.

Typical config we grant for accelerators: $1,000–$5,000 of platform credits per startup depending on cohort stage and size. For OrbitVC we can propose a $2,000 standard and scale if you have clear product integrations planned.

Looping in Marissa (Growth) for program terms and Karthik (Sales Relief) for any billing/contract questions.

—Aditya Rao
Partnerships, Redwood Inference
aditya_rao@redwood.ai
